paragraphs.text:
Something about the wretch chills you, but you put this subtle 
unease down to the effects of his long privation. You take the 
first watch while the students roll up in their blankets. As you 
sit on a rock, the first hour of the watch passes quietly.

Roll 1D6: if the result is 1–4, go to 194; if the result is 5–6, go 
to 193.
